google-account.label: Google account
google-account.description: Connect one Google account for Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Forms and Meet in your flows.
google-account.keywords: google, google account, calendar, sheets, docs, forms, meet, drive, oauth, connect google

page.title: Google account
page.subtitle: Connect once. The same Google account powers your booking calendar, Meet links and the Sheets, Docs and Forms steps in your flows.

forbidden.title: You cannot open this page
forbidden.body: Your role does not include viewing the Google account. Ask a workspace admin.

outcome.denied: Google was not connected: the permission screen was cancelled.
outcome.failed: Connecting Google did not finish. Try again.
outcome.expired: That connection attempt expired. Press the button to start again.
outcome.not_configured: Google is not set up for this platform yet. Ask your platform administrator.
outcome.missing_scope: Google did not give every permission you asked for. What was already allowed still works; add the missing ones again and keep every box ticked.

unavailable.title: Google is not set up for this platform
unavailable.body: The platform administrator has to add the Google OAuth client before anyone can connect. Until then Google steps in your flows fail with a message that says so, and bookings carry on without a calendar.

reconnect.title: Google stopped accepting this connection
reconnect.body: The permission was withdrawn, the password changed, or the grant expired. Connect again to restore it; your choices are kept.
reconnect.bodyAccount: Google stopped accepting {account}. Connect it again to restore it; your choices are kept.

account.title: Connected account
account.noneBody: Until you connect, Google steps in your flows fail with a message that says to connect Google, and bookings are not added to a calendar.

permissions.title: What Google may be used for
permissions.intro: Tick what you want to allow. Google shows exactly these permissions on its screen, and you can add more later without losing what is already allowed.
permissions.restrictedNote: Google treats this permission as restricted: the platform needs Google's review before it works for many workspaces. Leave it off unless you need it.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.body: Add bookings and Meet links to your calendar and hide busy times from the booking page.
calendar.usedBy: Booking calendar, Book appointment and Google Meet steps

sheets.name: Sheets
sheets.body: Add a row to a sheet, look a row up, check a cell or copy a row into a contact.
sheets.usedBy: Google Sheets, Check Google Sheet field, Save contact from Google Sheet

docs.name: Docs and Drive
docs.body: Copy a template document, fill it in and share the copy by link.

forms.name: Forms
forms.body: Read a form's public link so the flow can send it to the customer.

drive_listing.name: Drive file list
drive_listing.body: List your sheets, documents and forms by name in the flow builder, so you can pick instead of pasting a link.
drive_listing.usedBy: File pickers in the flow builder

lastError.title: The last problem Google reported
lastError.GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_NEEDS_RECONNECT: Google no longer accepts the connected account. Connect again.
lastError.GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The platform's Google client is missing or switched off.
lastError.GOOGLE_API_NOT_ENABLED: The platform's Google Cloud project has not enabled an API this feature needs. The platform administrator has to enable it.
lastError.GOOGLE_SCOPE_MISSING: A step needed a permission this account was not given. Add it above.
lastError.GOOGLE_RATE_LIMITED: Google is limiting requests right now. Steps are retried a moment later.
lastError.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google did not answer. It is tried again on the next use.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect Google?
disconnectConfirm.body: Calendar sync for bookings and every Google step in your flows stop until you connect again. Events and files already created stay in Google.

failure.notConfigured: Google is not set up for this platform. Ask your platform administrator.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Only the permissions you tick are requested. The connection is stored encrypted, belongs to the workspace and is used only by the features listed here. Disconnecting withdraws it at Google.

consent.title: Confirm Google connection
consent.question: Connect {email} to {workspace} for {permissions}?
consent.missing: Google did not give: {permissions}. If you confirm, only what was given is connected.
consent.replaces: This replaces the Google account {email} that is connected now. The access of the old account is withdrawn.
consent.onlyYou: Only the person who pressed Connect can finish this, from this workspace. If somebody sent you this link, do not confirm it: close the page.

failure.notYours: This Google connection was started by someone else, so it was not connected. Ask them to connect it themselves.
failure.expired: This Google connection took too long to confirm. Go back and press Connect again.
failure.used: This Google connection was already confirmed, cancelled or refused. Go back and press Connect again if you still need it.
failure.notFound: This Google connection is not waiting for confirmation, or it belongs to another workspace.
failure.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Try again.
